title: Junior AI/RAG Engineer
description: Meridian AI Labs is hiring a Junior AI Engineer to help build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems for enterprise document search. You will ingest and chunk documents, generate embeddings, maintain FAISS vector indexes and build FastAPI services that serve LLM-backed answers with source citations. You will work with LangChain, evaluate retrieval quality on real queries and write clean, tested Python. Requirements: strong Python and SQL fundamentals, a solid understanding of embeddings and vector search, hands-on use of an LLM API, and a comfortable Git workflow. Final-year students and recent graduates are welcome to apply.

title: Backend Python Developer
description: Cobaltree builds multi-tenant SaaS products for logistics companies. As a Backend Python Developer you will design and ship REST APIs with FastAPI, model data in PostgreSQL using SQLAlchemy, containerise services with Docker and deploy them on AWS. You will review pull requests, write unit tests and help the team improve API performance and reliability. We expect 1-3 years of professional experience building production web services in Python, a good grasp of relational databases, and familiarity with Git-based team workflows.

title: Full Stack Developer (React and Node.js)
description: Brightpath Digital is looking for a Full Stack Developer to build customer-facing dashboards and internal tools. You will create responsive interfaces in React styled with TailwindCSS, build REST APIs with Node.js and Express.js, and store data in PostgreSQL. You will turn designs into accessible components, integrate third-party APIs and take features from idea to production alongside a small, friendly team. Freshers with strong project work and 0-2 years of experience are encouraged to apply.
